response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over FROM budget) SELECT s.event_status, s.average_left_over, s.average_left_over - o.average_left_over AS difference_from_overall FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.average_left_over IS NOT NULL
